en-US.name: GIF Factory
en-US.summary: GIF creation skill with five companions, retaining the complete upstream Git source. Listing-only describes Market review/default-client budgets, not upstream unusability or an unknown license.
en-US.description: Pinned at e89003a4a6ca4fd0e9e39c8859851b58c82bc368; the root MIT LICENSE is inside the whole-repository install scope. The repository has 1295 files totaling 925968044 bytes (883.07 MiB); 245 files over 1 MiB sum to 676.31 MiB, not the total package size. Most bytes are examples (452.21 MiB) and skills resources (405.13 MiB). Automatic Market audit budgets are 1 MiB/file, 50 MiB total and 2000 files; budgetExemptPaths only exempts the per-file limit. At client e817d57e, the pinned-Git cache defaults are 200 MiB checkout and 256 MiB object repository, overridable through internal SourceFetchOptions.limits; ZIP settings do not configure Git. These are not absolute upstream Git limits. Original pin, structure, demos, resources and install method are preserved; no slim package, custom fetch or fabricated admission receipt.

zh-CN.description: 固定版本 e89003a4a6ca4fd0e9e39c8859851b58c82bc368，MIT LICENSE 位于整库安装范围内。整库 1295 个文件，共 925968044 bytes（883.07 MiB）；245 个超过 1 MiB 的文件合计 676.31 MiB，后者不是整个包大小。主要是 examples 演示（452.21 MiB）和 skills 资源（405.13 MiB）。市场自动审核阈值为单文件 1 MiB/总计 50 MiB/2000 文件；budgetExemptPaths 只豁免单文件阈值，不提高总预算。客户端 e817d57e 的固定 SHA Git 缓存路径默认检出 200 MiB、对象库 256 MiB，内部 SourceFetchOptions.limits 可覆盖；ZIP 设置不覆盖 Git 预算。不是上游 Git 的绝对大小限制。保留原 pin、结构、演示、资源与安装方式，未提供精简包或按需 fetch，未伪造准入回执。
